data.case_title: Vehicle tax assessment (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) – new annual amount of €238
data.title: Kraftfahrzeugsteuer-Bescheid: tax raised to €238/year from 1 October 2025
data.summary: Hauptzollamt Beispielstein has reassessed the vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for the vehicle with plate OS-NM 905, setting it to €238.00 per year effective 1 October 2025, due to a conversion that increased the permissible towing weight. The amount continues to be collected by direct debit as before.
data.explanation: This is an official notice from the customs office (Hauptzollamt), which administers German vehicle tax. Because the vehicle was modified for towing with a higher permissible weight, the annual tax was recalculated to €238.00, starting 1 October 2025. The amount will keep being collected automatically by direct debit, so no payment action is needed from you. If you disagree with this new assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Hauptzollamt in writing, electronically, or on record; the app will show the deadline for this. If you let the deadline pass without objecting, the assessment becomes final.

key_facts.label: Objection period (Einspruchsfrist)
key_facts.quote:
Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat; sie beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe,
die bei einfachem Brief am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als erfolgt gilt.

remedy.quote:
Einspruch gegen diese Festsetzung ist beim Hauptzollamt Beispielstein einzulegen – schriftlich,
elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.

items.title: Vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) direct debit
items.action: No action needed – the annual vehicle tax is collected automatically by direct debit as before.

items.action: If you disagree with the new tax amount or its basis, you may file a written, electronic, or recorded objection (Einspruch) with Hauptzollamt Beispielstein by the deadline shown.
